request.query: financing offering listing compliance reverse split PIPE financing securities purchase agreement at-the-market sales agreement equity offering convertible note conversion pre-funded warrant reverse merger investment grade credit rating credit facility amendment

request.description: Elevated cash burn rate: the ratio of absolute operating cash outflow to cash and cash equivalents is high, indicating rapid cash consumption. Positive when point-in-time evidence shows operating cash outflow is negative and the ratio meets or exceeds the threshold, or documents explicitly describe a high cash burn rate. Negative when evidence shows positive operating cash flow, no material cash consumption, or an explicit denial/cancellation of a high burn. Neutral for proposals, memoranda, non-binding intent, lookalikes, or below-threshold mentions. Unavailable when adequate point-in-time evidence is missing.
request.query: cash burn rate operating cash flow cash and cash equivalents NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue

request.description: Read the latest point-in-time cash and equivalents balance.
request.query: cash and equivalents cash balance liquidity

request.description: Measure the ratio of latest CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue to latest LiabilitiesCurrent for a company as of a point in time. Higher values indicate stronger short-term liquidity.
request.query: CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue LiabilitiesCurrent cash current liabilities liquidity ratio 10-Q 10-K 20-F SEC company facts USD

request.description: Measure the latest point-in-time change in gross margin.

Assess a company's estimated liquidity runway in months, computed as latest point-in-time CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue divided by the absolute monthly-average NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities over the reported period. A runway at or below 6 months is positive evidence of near-term financing dependence; a runway at or above 12 months or explicit denial/cancellation of a low-runway condition is negative; intermediate or non-qualifying narrative is neutral; insufficient point-in-time inputs are unavailable.
request.query: CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities liquidity runway operating cash flow cash burn months
